records.source: Sebastian has a grin on his face.
records.translation: Nakangisi si Sebastian.

records.source: Best movie I've seen in a while... I wonder how they did some of those special effects?$h
records.translation: Pinakamagandang pelikulang napanood ko nitong mga huli... Paano kaya nila ginawa ang ilan sa mga espesyal na epektong iyon?$h

records.source: *shrugs*... The movie poster looked pretty cool, so I'm in.
records.translation: *kibit-balikat*... Mukhang astig ang poster ng pelikula, kaya sasama ako.

records.source: It wasn't the best ever, but I had a pretty good time... thanks for inviting me.
records.translation: Hindi iyon ang pinakamahusay, pero nasiyahan naman ako... salamat sa pag-imbita sa akin.

records.source: I hope it's short...
records.translation: Sana ay maikli lamang ito...

records.source: It's probably a fine movie for the target audience, but it's just not for me.
records.translation: Maaaring magandang pelikula ito para sa nilalayong manonood, pero hindi talaga ito para sa akin.

records.source: I've been feeling kind of dull lately, so an action-packed movie is exactly what I need.
records.translation: Medyo nananamlay ako nitong mga huli, kaya isang pelikulang punô ng aksiyon ang mismong kailangan ko.

records.source: I'm all fired up, now! That was great.$h
records.translation: Punô ako ng sigla ngayon! Napakaganda niyon.$h

records.source: I'm not sure what this movie's about, but I don't really care! It's just good to get out of the house.
records.translation: Hindi ko tiyak kung tungkol saan ang pelikulang ito, pero wala akong pakialam! Mabuti nang makalabas ng bahay.

records.source: That was a lot of fun, @. I'm glad we did this.
records.translation: Napakasaya niyon, @. Natutuwa akong ginawa natin ito.

records.source: A short jaunt in the snow really gets the blood flowing.
records.translation: Talagang nagpapadaloy ng dugo ang maikling paglalakad sa niyebe.

records.source: Longings of the heart...? Oh! You mean 'elevated levels of oxytocin in the limbic system'.
records.translation: Pananabik ng puso...? Oh! Ang ibig mong sabihin ay 'mataas na antas ng oxytocin sa sistemang limbiko'.

records.source: Demetrius is furrowing his brow.
records.translation: Kumukunot ang noo ni Demetrius.

records.source: The art of film has come a long way since those times, hasn't it?
records.translation: Malayo na ang narating ng sining ng pelikula mula noong mga panahong iyon, hindi ba?

records.source: This movie supposedly takes place in a 'futuristic' society... it will be interesting to see what that looks like!
records.translation: Nagaganap daw ang pelikulang ito sa isang 'futuristikong' lipunan... magiging kawili-wiling makita kung ano ang anyo niyon!

records.source: Great movie... but I wonder if there really is life beyond this planet?
records.translation: Napakagandang pelikula... pero mayroon nga kayang buhay sa labas ng planetang ito?

records.source: This one's right up my alley... you know I'm gonna love this.$h
records.translation: Swak na swak ito sa interes ko... alam mong magugustuhan ko ito.$h

records.source: Technically, that's not correct...$3
records.translation: Kung teknikal ang pag-uusapan, hindi iyan tama...$3

records.source: Demetrius is scratching his chin...
records.translation: Kinakamot ni Demetrius ang kaniyang baba...

records.source: Well, they definitely embellished some things, but it was still mostly correct! Anyway, I had a good time.
records.translation: Talagang pinalabis nila ang ilang bagay, pero tama pa rin ang karamihan! Gayunman, nasiyahan ako.

records.source: I read about this one in the paper... didn't seem like the thing for me. But I'll give it a shot.
records.translation: Nabasa ko ang tungkol dito sa pahayagan... Mukhang hindi ito para sa akin. Pero susubukan ko.

records.source: Nonsense! That was totally unscientific!$4
records.translation: Kalokohan! Talagang hindi makaagham iyon!$4

records.source: Even if a movie is bad, it's interesting to analyze.
records.translation: Kahit pangit ang isang pelikula, kawili-wili pa rin itong suriin.

records.source: Hmm... I wonder what aspect of human motivation is satisfied by the narrative of this film?$3
records.translation: Hmm... Anong aspekto kaya ng motibasyon ng tao ang natutugunan ng salaysay ng pelikulang ito?$3

records.source: I feel out of place here... I hope I'm not bothering anyone.$s
records.translation: Pakiramdam ko ay hindi ako nababagay rito... Sana ay wala akong naaabala.$s

records.source: Linus is looking at the floor...
records.translation: Nakatingin si Linus sa sahig...

records.source: Why stare at a screen when you could experience these things yourself?$s
records.translation: Bakit ka tititig sa isang tabing kung maaari mo namang maranasan mismo ang mga bagay na ito?$s

records.source: I feel out of place here... I hope I'm not bothering anyone.$s
records.translation: Pakiramdam ko ay hindi ako nababagay rito... Sana ay wala akong naaabala.$s

records.source: Linus is looking at the floor...
records.translation: Nakatingin si Linus sa sahig...

records.source: I'm not used to that much stimulation... sorry if I was a disappointing guest, @. I still appreciate your inviting me!
records.translation: Hindi ako sanay sa ganoon karaming nangyayari sa paligid... paumanhin kung hindi ako naging mabuting panauhin, @. Pinahahalagahan ko pa rin ang pag-imbita mo sa akin!
